entries.difference: 连续动作块与Flow Matching策略，适合研究视觉、语言和动作的结合。
entries.recommendation: 先看数据接口与推理；有机器人数据或仿真任务后再微调。

en.title: OpenPI: pi0 and pi0.5
en.summary: Open implementations of pi0-family robot policies.
en.difference: Uses continuous action chunks and flow-based policies, providing a contrast to tokenized-action approaches.
en.recommendation: Begin with data interfaces and inference before attempting task-specific fine-tuning.
en.personal: Begin with public data and simulation; real-world experiments need compatible robot hardware.

entries.title: OpenVLA · 视觉语言动作模型
entries.summary: 由视觉语言输入产生动作 token，理解 VLM 到机器人策略的适配。
entries.prereq: CS224N、行为克隆、机器人数据与动作归一化。
entry: README：模型、数据与输入输出
vla-scripts/finetune.py：微调数据流
阅读 prismatic 中动作 token 与 VLA 模型
entries.personal: 可先读公开数据与推理接口；实机实验需要机器人设备，完整训练另需GPU。
entries.note: LeRobot之后的动作token路线，与OpenPI的连续动作生成对照；不要求先完成OpenVLA才可读OpenPI。
entries.difference: 将视觉语言模型连接到动作token预测，可与OpenPI的连续动作路线比较。
entries.recommendation: 先读动作表示和数据处理；与OpenPI选一个做主要策略项目。

en.title: OpenVLA
en.summary: An open vision-language-action model.
en.difference: Connects a vision-language model to action-token prediction, contrasting with continuous-action policies.
en.recommendation: Study action representation and preprocessing; choose one main VLA policy project.
en.personal: Begin with public data and simulation; real-world experiments need compatible robot hardware.

entries.title: LeRobot · 机器人学习工具链
entries.summary: 组织机器人数据、策略训练、评估、推理和设备接口，衔接 VLA 模型。
entries.prereq: PyTorch、行为克隆、机器人观测与动作。
entry: Quickstart：数据集与策略接口
阅读 dataset / policies / configs
阅读训练与评估脚本
entries.personal: 可先读公开数据与推理接口；实机实验需要机器人设备，完整训练另需GPU。
entries.note: 机器人线的起点，先了解数据集、策略、训练与评估接口，可先使用公开数据。
entries.difference: 覆盖机器人数据、训练、评估与设备接入的工具链，不只是一种模型。
entries.recommendation: 机器人方向先从它理解数据格式与回放，再选具体策略。

en.title: LeRobot
en.summary: A robotics learning toolkit spanning data, training, evaluation and devices.
en.difference: Provides the workflow around policies rather than a single policy architecture.
en.recommendation: Use it to learn dataset formats and replay before choosing a policy.
en.personal: Begin with public data and simulation; real-world experiments need compatible robot hardware.

entries.title: LeeDL-Tutorial · 苹果书
entries.summary: 整理李宏毅课程的文字、视频和代码，适合作为Zero to Hero或鱼书的另一种讲解。
entries.prereq: Python、基础线性代数与导数；代码练习需要逐步熟悉 PyTorch。

links.title: 李宏毅原课：视频 / 课件 / 作业

entry: 作为中文深度学习入门主课，之后读 Happy-LLM。原课网站提供视频、课件和作业安排。
entries.personal: 先读文档和小例子；完整训练按原项目的硬件说明。
entries.note: 偏好中文视频与课程讲解时，用李宏毅原课配合苹果书替换鱼书；原课作业与参考实现另附链接。
entries.audience: 喜欢中文讲解，希望系统补深度学习的人。

en.title: LeeDL Tutorial
en.summary: Organizes Hung-yi Lee's lectures, notes and code. An alternative explanation alongside an implementation-focused course.
en.audience: Learners who prefer Chinese explanations of deep learning.
en.prereq: Python and basic mathematics.

entries.title: Pumpkin Book · 南瓜书
entries.summary: 补全《机器学习》（西瓜书）中的公式推导，适合解释回归、概率模型、优化等数学细节。
entries.prereq: 以西瓜书正文为前置；需要线性代数、微积分与概率基础。
entry: 放在机器学习阶段作为公式查阅。先读对应的西瓜书内容，遇到推导再用南瓜书配套视频。
entries.personal: 公开公式推导资料，配合西瓜书阅读。
entries.note: 西瓜书的公式推导伴读。CS229与西瓜书概念有交集，南瓜书不独立排成另一门主课。

en.title: Pumpkin Book
en.summary: Derivations and explanations accompanying the Chinese Watermelon machine-learning textbook.
en.audience: Readers who need the mathematical steps behind the textbook.
en.personal: Public companion derivations; the main textbook is separate.

entries.title: Happy-LLM · 从零构建大模型
entries.summary: 从语言模型基础讲到Transformer、预训练与微调。适合先建立全貌，再用CS336完成工程实现。
entries.prereq: Python 与 PyTorch 基础，理解张量、自动求导和训练循环。
entry: 作为中文大模型主课：学完 PyTorch 后进入，再衔接 nanoGPT、MiniMind 和 CS336。
entries.personal: 先读文档和小例子；完整训练按原项目的硬件说明。
entries.note: 中文主课：阶段04学NLP、Transformer、LLaMA与预训练；阶段05接微调和Agentic-RL。模型实现只做CS336 A1。
entries.audience: 会Python与基础深度学习，想用中文理解LLM的人。

en.title: Happy-LLM
en.summary: Introduces language models, Transformers, pretraining and fine-tuning. Build a conceptual map here, then use CS336 for deeper implementation.
en.audience: Learners seeking a Chinese introduction to LLMs.
en.prereq: Python, neural networks and basic PyTorch.

entries.title: LLMs From Scratch CN · 动手学 LLM
entries.summary: 围绕文本处理、注意力和GPT实现展开。与Happy-LLM和Raschka原书重叠，可作为配套解释。
entries.prereq: PyTorch 与 Transformer 基础。适合喜欢 Notebook 逐格追踪张量形状的人。
entry: 放在 Happy-LLM 的模型实现主题之后，选作更细的 Notebook 实现路线，然后进入 nanoGPT。
entries.personal: 先读文档和小例子；完整训练按原项目的硬件说明。
entries.note: 偏好逐格Notebook时，可替代CS336 A1的入门实现过程；不替代A2–A5。目录中未发布部分不安排为任务。
entries.status: 当前 README 将第6—8章列为“即将发布”；已列出的核心代码以文本、注意力、GPT 和预训练为主，不将待发布章节视为可用课程。
entries.audience: 想用中文逐步阅读从零实现LLM代码的人。

en.title: LLMs From Scratch CN
en.summary: Covers text processing, attention and GPT construction. Overlaps with Happy-LLM and Raschka's book; use it as a companion.
en.audience: Learners reading an LLM implementation with Chinese explanations.
en.prereq: Python, PyTorch and neural-network fundamentals.

entries.title: Self-LLM · 开源大模型使用指南
entries.summary: 按模型整理部署、推理与微调实践。适合作为操作手册，不需要把全部模型逐个做完。
entries.prereq: Python、Linux 命令行与模型使用基础；训练部分需要 PyTorch 与微调概念。
entry: 先看所选模型的环境与推理教程，再看同模型的微调；按需选择一个模型目录。
entries.personal: 先读文档和小例子；完整训练按原项目的硬件说明。
entries.note: 按当前模型和硬件查部署与微调方法，不需要逐个模型全部学习。
entries.audience: 已懂微调原理，想查具体开源模型配置的人。

en.title: Self-LLM
en.summary: Provides model-specific deployment, inference and fine-tuning guides. Use the relevant model guide as a reference.
en.audience: Users deploying or fine-tuning a particular open model.
en.prereq: Python, a chosen model and basic fine-tuning knowledge.

entries.title: So-Large-LM · 大模型理论专题
entries.summary: 按主题整理大模型架构、训练与相关研究，适合遇到问题时选读。
entries.prereq: 已经了解 Transformer 和基本训练流程。
entry: 在 Happy-LLM 或 CS336 学习中按主题查阅，适合补理论全景。
entries.personal: 先读文档和小例子；完整训练按原项目的硬件说明。
entries.note: 数据、架构、训练和分布式专题参考，与CS336重合，不追加整课。
entries.audience: 已有LLM基础，想补论文和理论脉络的人。

en.title: So-Large-LM
en.summary: Collects architecture, training and research topics. Best used for targeted reading after an introductory course.
en.audience: Learners extending an existing LLM foundation.
en.prereq: Transformer, pretraining and post-training fundamentals.

entries.title: Tiny-Universe · 白盒实现合集
entries.summary: 从底层实现 Tiny Transformer、Tiny LLM、Tiny RAG、Tiny Agent、Tiny Eval、GraphRAG 与 Diffusion。
entries.prereq: 有深度学习基础，了解所选模块的基本流程。
entry: 完成对应课程后挑一个模块练手：模型课后看 Tiny LLM，RAG 课后看 Tiny RAG，生成模型课后看 Tiny Diffusion。
entries.personal: 先读文档和小例子；完整训练按原项目的硬件说明。
entries.note: 按已学主题选Tiny模块：模型、RAG、Agent或Diffusion。不是需要从头全部完成的一条新路线。
entries.difference: 中文白盒小实现集合，便于对照不同组件；不适合作为全部通读的主线。
entries.recommendation: 已有一个模型项目后，按当前组件查阅相应小实现。

en.title: Tiny-Universe
en.summary: A collection of small, readable AI implementations in Chinese.
en.difference: Useful for comparing components, but less focused than one continuous model-building course.
en.recommendation: Consult the relevant implementation when a component becomes important.
en.personal: Small examples can be inspected and run on CPU.

entries.title: LLM Cookbook · 吴恩达短课中文实践
entries.summary: 汇集吴恩达相关短课的中文讲解与Notebook，覆盖提示、检索和应用工作流。
entries.prereq: 基础 Python，能读 Jupyter Notebook；部分示例需要模型 API。
entry: 想先做应用时，可先看提示与 API 实践，再接 LLM Universe。
entries.personal: 先读文档和小例子；完整训练按原项目的硬件说明。
entries.note: 提示/API/框架的短课选读，可作为LLM Universe的替代入门；与All-in-RAG基础部分有重合。
entries.audience: 想用中文做短小LLM应用练习的人。

en.title: LLM Cookbook
en.summary: Collects Chinese explanations and notebooks for short courses on prompting, retrieval and application workflows.
en.audience: Learners who prefer short, practical LLM exercises in Chinese.
en.prereq: Python and access to the models required by each notebook.

entries.title: LLM Universe · 首个知识库应用
entries.summary: 从环境、模型接入和向量知识库开始搭建LLM应用。基础部分与All-in-RAG重叠，先选一套完成。
entries.prereq: Python、基本命令行操作，理解如何调用一个模型。

links.title: 按章节阅读与运行 Notebook

entry: 先做一套完整知识库 Demo，再进入 All-in-RAG 学习检索优化与评估。
entries.personal: 先读文档和小例子；完整训练按原项目的硬件说明。
entries.note: 需要更缓的应用入门时，先做它的知识库Demo，再接All-in-RAG的优化与评估；基础建库流程不重复做。
entries.status: README 将进阶 RAG 部分标为创作中，学习时以实际已有章节和代码为准。
entries.audience: 想先做一个完整知识库应用的新手。

en.title: LLM Universe
en.summary: Builds an LLM application through setup, model integration and vector retrieval. Its introductory RAG work overlaps with All-in-RAG.
en.audience: Beginners building a first knowledge-base application.
en.prereq: Python and basic LLM usage.

entries.title: All-in-RAG · 检索增强生成全栈
entries.summary: 按数据处理、切块、检索、重排、生成与评估组织实践，适合做第二版知识库系统。
entries.prereq: Python，基本 Linux 与 Docker 操作，能理解一个简单的 RAG 流程。
entry: 作为 RAG 专项主课；先把基础链路走通，再学习优化、评估和项目一。
entries.personal: 先读文档和小例子；完整训练按原项目的硬件说明。
entries.note: RAG专项主课，依次完成检索链路、优化、评估与项目一；GraphRAG作为该项目的进阶。
entries.status: 第十章项目二在 README 中仍标为规划中；不把它作为当前可直接完成的项目。
entries.audience: 已会Python和模型API，想系统学习RAG的人。

en.title: All-in-RAG
en.summary: Covers data preparation, chunking, retrieval, reranking, generation and evaluation. Useful for improving a first knowledge-base system.
en.audience: Builders seeking a structured RAG curriculum.
en.prereq: Python and LLM API basics.

entries.title: Hello-Agents · 从零构建智能体
entries.summary: 从工具调用和Agent循环走向记忆、规划、框架与应用。适合作为Agent方向的中文主课。
entries.prereq: Python，了解模型 API；Agentic-RL 内容另需训练与强化学习基础。

links.title: 从零构建 Agent 框架

entry: 作为中文 Agent 主课；应用和 RAG 基础之后进入。先理解工具循环，再做框架与综合项目。
entries.personal: 先读文档和小例子；完整训练按原项目的硬件说明。
entries.note: 中文Agent主课，按工具循环、框架、记忆、上下文、评估到综合项目学习。训练相关Agentic-RL接已有后训练/RL知识。
entries.audience: 想用中文理解并实现Agent的人。

en.title: Hello-Agents
en.summary: Moves from tool calls and the agent loop to memory, planning, frameworks and applications. A useful main course for the agent track.
en.audience: Learners building agents with Chinese explanations.
en.prereq: Python, LLM APIs and basic software engineering.

entries.title: Easy-RL · 蘑菇书
entries.summary: 从MDP、价值函数和策略讲到常见RL算法。之后再用CleanRL读实现或学习CS285。
entries.prereq: 概率、期望、梯度与 PyTorch；先有普通监督训练基础。
entry: 可作为 CS285 前的中文入门，或与 CS285 对应算法配套阅读。
entries.personal: 先读文档和小例子；完整训练按原项目的硬件说明。
entries.note: CS285的中文基础伴读，也可在英文主课前先学。MDP、PPO、DQN等算法只做一套首次实现。
entries.audience: 想先用中文建立强化学习概念的人。

en.title: Easy-RL
en.summary: Builds the concepts of MDPs, value functions, policies and common RL algorithms. Follow it with CleanRL or a university course.
en.audience: Learners seeking an introductory RL text in Chinese.
en.prereq: Probability, calculus and Python.

entries.title: Zero-to-SGLang · 从零手搓推理引擎
entries.summary: 按请求、KV Cache、Prefill/Decode与调度解释推理系统。与nano-vLLM或mini-SGLang配合阅读。
entries.prereq: 熟悉 Python、PyTorch、矩阵运算和注意力；概念部分不需要 GPU。

links.title: 请求生命周期：代码走读

entry: 作为中文推理系统主课：模型基础 → 推理原理与实现 → 官方 mini-SGLang → SGLang。
entries.personal: 先读文档和小例子；完整训练按原项目的硬件说明。
entries.note: 中文推理系统课程，连接prefill/decode、KV Cache、调度与引擎源码；只安排实际发布的章节。
entries.status: 持续更新：中文目录中的连续批处理、投机解码及部分高级主题仍为筹备中。上面只列已有链接的章节。
entries.audience: 想从小型推理引擎理解LLM服务的人。

en.title: Zero-to-SGLang
en.summary: Explains requests, KV caches, prefill/decode and scheduling through a small implementation. Pair with nano-vLLM or mini-SGLang.
en.audience: Learners studying how an LLM inference engine works.
en.prereq: Python, Transformers, GPU memory and basic systems concepts.

entries.title: Easy-Vibe · AI 应用产品实践
entries.summary: 从需求和交互进入原型与产品实践，侧重做出应用；模型原理和训练另走基础路线。
entries.prereq: 入门路径对编程要求较低；完整工程项目仍需逐步补前后端与部署基础。
entries.language: 按项目使用 Python / JavaScript 等
entry: 放在模型或 Agent 课程之后作为产品支线，按想做的应用选项目。
entries.personal: 先读文档和小例子；完整训练按原项目的硬件说明。
entries.note: 把模型或Agent做成产品时的工程支线，按需求、原型、前后端与部署选项目。
entries.audience: 想借助AI工具完成一个应用原型的人。

en.title: Easy-Vibe
en.summary: Connects requirements, interactions, prototyping and product practice. Use a separate course for model theory and training.
en.audience: Learners using AI tools to build an application prototype.
en.prereq: Basic programming and an application idea.

entries.title: 鱼书 · 深度学习入门
entries.summary: 用 NumPy 从感知机、反向传播走到 CNN；配套8章官方 Notebook 已下载。
entries.prereq: Python、NumPy与基本导数。
entry: 默认深度学习入门教材，按第2–8章实现感知机、网络、反向传播、训练技巧和CNN。第1章与Python阶段重合，可按需查阅。
entries.personal: 中文书通常购买；官方Python与Notebook配套代码开放。
entries.note: 默认深度学习入门教材，按第2–8章实现感知机、网络、反向传播、训练技巧和CNN。第1章与Python阶段重合，可按需查阅。

en.title: Deep Learning from Scratch
en.summary: Implements neural-network fundamentals with Python and NumPy, including backpropagation and CNNs.
en.audience: Learners who prefer a compact, code-oriented introduction.
en.personal: The book is commercially published; official code and notebooks are public.

entries.title: TRL · SFT / DPO / GRPO / OPD
entries.summary: 后训练主项目：指令微调、偏好优化、规则奖励与在线蒸馏。
entries.prereq: Python、PyTorch；理解当前项目涉及的模型或算法。

entries.recommendation: SFT/LoRA之后做DPO，再做GRPO；最后看在线蒸馏。

en.title: TRL
en.summary: Trainers for supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, RL and distillation.
en.difference: Makes changes in datasets, objectives and rollout pipelines explicit across methods.
en.recommendation: Follow SFT with DPO, then GRPO; leave online distillation until later.
en.personal: Choose a small model or notebook first; memory requirements depend on the model, method and configuration.

entries.title: verl · 分布式后训练
entries.summary: 把rollout、奖励、策略更新放进分布式训练流程。
entries.prereq: Python、PyTorch；理解当前项目涉及的模型或算法。
entry: TRL之后的工程进阶。先做GRPO，再看OPD；官方GSM8K快速开始要求至少24GB显存。
entries.personal: 个人先读推理/训练样例；性能或分布式实验需要相应GPU资源。
entries.note: TRL之后的工程进阶。先做GRPO，再看OPD；官方GSM8K快速开始要求至少24GB显存。
entries.difference: 将rollout、奖励和策略更新组织成分布式后训练流水线。
entries.recommendation: 已理解TRL和单机训练后再读，用它研究资源调度与多进程协作。

en.title: verl
en.summary: A distributed post-training framework.
en.difference: Coordinates rollout, rewards and policy updates across distributed workers.
en.recommendation: Read after a simpler trainer; focus on worker roles, scheduling and data movement.
en.personal: Choose a small model or notebook first; memory requirements depend on the model, method and configuration.

entries.title: OpenRLHF · RLHF 工程
entries.summary: Ray与vLLM上的奖励模型、PPO和GRPO训练。
entries.prereq: Python、PyTorch；理解当前项目涉及的模型或算法。
entry: 与verl二选一作为分布式练手。先做TRL，无需再完整训练两套工程框架。
entries.personal: 个人先读推理/训练样例；性能或分布式实验需要相应GPU资源。
entries.note: 与verl二选一作为分布式练手。先做TRL，无需再完整训练两套工程框架。
entries.difference: 基于Ray等组件组织RLHF工程，适合与verl比较训练与推理协同。
entries.recommendation: 与verl先选一个深入，避免同时配置两套分布式训练栈。

en.title: OpenRLHF
en.summary: A distributed RLHF framework.
en.difference: Offers an alternative organization of training and inference components to verl.
en.recommendation: Choose either verl or OpenRLHF as the first distributed post-training framework.
en.personal: Choose a small model or notebook first; memory requirements depend on the model, method and configuration.

entries.title: Reasoning from Scratch · 推理模型
entries.summary: Sebastian Raschka的推理模型代码：评估、GRPO与蒸馏。
entries.prereq: Python、PyTorch；理解当前项目涉及的模型或算法。
entry: 看清算法时用的手写实现。配合TRL读GRPO和蒸馏，不另外重做整条训练路线。
entries.personal: 先读文档和小例子；完整训练按原项目的硬件说明。
entries.note: 看清算法时用的手写实现。配合TRL读GRPO和蒸馏，不另外重做整条训练路线。
entries.difference: 以教学代码拆解推理评估、GRPO和蒸馏，比完整分布式框架更容易追算法。
entries.recommendation: 和TRL形成原理与工具对照，先读小例子再追框架实现。

en.title: Reasoning from Scratch
en.summary: Educational code for reasoning-model evaluation, GRPO and distillation.
en.difference: Easier to trace algorithmically than a large distributed training stack.
en.recommendation: Pair it with TRL: inspect the small algorithm before the framework abstraction.
en.personal: Choose a small model or notebook first; memory requirements depend on the model, method and configuration.

entries.title: nanochat
entries.summary: 从分词、预训练走到聊天微调和评估的紧凑实现。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 先跑官方小规模配置，再对照tokenizer、训练与聊天入口。
entries.personal: 小规模先跑；完整复现按官方GPU配置。
entries.difference: 从Tokenizer到预训练、对话微调和评估的端到端项目，比nanoGPT更完整。
entries.recommendation: 在tiny GPT和CS336 A1之后读，先缩小模型与数据看流程。

en.title: nanochat
en.summary: An end-to-end small chat-model pipeline.
en.difference: Extends beyond nanoGPT to tokenization, training, conversational adaptation and evaluation.
en.recommendation: Read after a tiny GPT project; reduce model and data size to inspect the pipeline.
en.personal: Start with a small model and dataset; full-scale training requires substantially more compute.

entries.title: llm.c
entries.summary: 用C/CUDA理解GPT训练与GPU优化。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 先读CPU参考实现，再研究CUDA训练内核。
entries.personal: CPU参考可读可跑；CUDA实验需要NVIDIA GPU。
entries.difference: 用C/CUDA实现语言模型训练，适合理解算子、内存与GPU性能。
entries.recommendation: 先会PyTorch训练和C，再比较相同操作在低层实现中的数据流。

en.title: llm.c
en.summary: Language-model training implemented in C and CUDA.
en.difference: Exposes kernels and memory behavior hidden behind a high-level training library.
en.recommendation: Learn PyTorch and C first, then trace equivalent operations at the lower level.
en.personal: Start with a small model and dataset; full-scale training requires substantially more compute.

entries.title: LitGPT
entries.summary: 整理常见LLM的预训练、微调与推理流程。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 选一种小模型，从下载权重、推理和微调开始。
entries.personal: 小模型与单卡配置优先。
entries.difference: 包含模型、训练和微调工作流的工具化实现，强调已有模型的使用与扩展。
entries.recommendation: 在理解最小训练循环后选一个小模型，比较配置式工程和手写流程。

en.title: LitGPT
en.summary: A toolkit for training and adapting language models.
en.difference: Offers a more configurable workflow than a minimal teaching implementation.
en.recommendation: Use one small model after you understand the basic training loop.
en.personal: Start with a small model and dataset; full-scale training requires substantially more compute.

entries.title: SmolLM
entries.summary: 小型语言模型、训练配方与相关工具。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 先读小模型训练配方，再追数据、训练与评估配置。
entries.personal: 可先使用现成模型；完整预训练通常需要多卡。
entries.difference: 开放小模型及相关训练资料，适合研究模型大小、数据与能力之间的关系。
entries.recommendation: 作为小模型配方参考，与MiniMind或nanochat比较数据和评估。

en.title: SmolLM
en.summary: A family of small language models and training resources.
en.difference: Useful for studying relationships between scale, data and capability.
en.recommendation: Compare its data and evaluation choices with MiniMind or nanochat.
en.personal: Start with a small model and dataset; full-scale training requires substantially more compute.

entries.title: OLMo
entries.summary: 开放语言模型训练代码与研究配方。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 阅读训练配置、数据混合和检查点，先缩小配置。
entries.personal: 适合研究代码；大规模预训练需要集群。
entries.difference: 强调开放的模型、数据与训练研究资料，便于研究可复现性。
entries.recommendation: 读配方、日志和数据说明；个人实验使用缩小版本，不追完整规模。

en.title: OLMo
en.summary: Open language-model research resources and training implementations.
en.difference: Particularly useful for examining training recipes, data provenance and reproducibility.
en.recommendation: Read the recipe and logs, then reduce the scale for personal experiments.
en.personal: Start with a small model and dataset; full-scale training requires substantially more compute.

entries.title: DataTrove
entries.summary: 文本数据的读取、过滤、去重和处理管线。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 用一小份语料跑过滤和去重，观察前后样本。
entries.personal: 小数据可在CPU上完成。
entries.difference: 面向文本语料处理的流水线，重点是过滤、去重与数据准备，不负责凭空生成知识。
entries.recommendation: 先处理一小批真实文本，记录每个过滤步骤对数量和质量的影响。

en.title: DataTrove
en.summary: A pipeline toolkit for text-corpus processing.
en.difference: Focuses on preparing, filtering and deduplicating data rather than generating new examples.
en.recommendation: Process a small real corpus and inspect the effect of every filtering stage.
en.personal: Begin with small datasets. Model-generated examples require a configured endpoint and may incur inference costs.

entries.title: Distilabel
entries.summary: 用模型生成、评审和整理合成训练数据。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 先做指令生成，再加评分、过滤与去重。
entries.personal: 小批量数据即可；模型API或本地推理。
entries.difference: 用LLM构造指令、偏好与评估数据，适合连接数据生成和后训练。
entries.recommendation: 数据合成入门先做一条生成—评分—过滤流水线，再接训练器。

en.title: Distilabel
en.summary: Pipelines for LLM-generated and labeled training data.
en.difference: Closely connects synthetic instruction or preference data to model post-training.
en.recommendation: Build one generation, scoring and filtering pipeline before feeding a trainer.
en.personal: Begin with small datasets. Model-generated examples require a configured endpoint and may incur inference costs.

entries.title: Datasets
entries.summary: 加载、变换、筛选与流式处理训练数据。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 先做load、map、filter，再划分训练与验证数据。
entries.personal: CPU与小数据即可。
entries.difference: 数据加载、映射、流式读取与分享的底层工具，不是模型也不是生成框架。
entries.recommendation: 所有数据项目的先修工具；先熟悉map、拆分、缓存和数据模式。

en.title: Hugging Face Datasets
en.summary: A toolkit for loading, transforming and sharing datasets.
en.difference: Provides data infrastructure rather than a model or synthetic-data generator.
en.recommendation: Learn mapping, splitting, caching, schemas and streaming before a larger data project.
en.personal: Begin with small datasets. Model-generated examples require a configured endpoint and may incur inference costs.

entries.title: LlamaFactory
entries.summary: 常见开源模型的SFT、LoRA与偏好训练工具。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 先用小模型做一次LoRA SFT，再看偏好数据配置。
entries.personal: 先选单卡小模型；显存要求随模型和配置变化。
entries.difference: 将多模型微调流程做成统一配置与界面，降低实验配置成本。
entries.recommendation: 想先跑通SFT/LoRA可用它；想追训练算法时回到TRL或MiniMind。

en.title: LlamaFactory
en.summary: A unified interface for adapting many language models.
en.difference: Reduces configuration effort through standardized workflows, rather than teaching every algorithm from first principles.
en.recommendation: Use for a first SFT or LoRA run; return to TRL or MiniMind for the algorithm.
en.personal: Choose a small model or notebook first; memory requirements depend on the model, method and configuration.

entries.title: Unsloth
entries.summary: 面向高效微调与RL训练的工具和Notebook。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 优先选官方小模型Notebook，再改数据和训练参数。
entries.personal: 单卡/Notebook示例优先，按示例检查GPU要求。
entries.difference: 侧重高效微调与训练实现，提供便于起步的Notebook和模型适配。
entries.recommendation: 资源有限时优先查看其支持模型和Notebook，再与常规训练器比较。

en.title: Unsloth
en.summary: Efficient model-adaptation tools and notebooks.
en.difference: Focuses on practical training efficiency and supported model integrations.
en.recommendation: Check supported models and notebooks, then compare with a standard trainer on the same task.
en.personal: Choose a small model or notebook first; memory requirements depend on the model, method and configuration.

entries.title: Alignment Handbook
entries.summary: SFT与偏好对齐的训练配方。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 先理解数据格式，再比较SFT与DPO的配置。
entries.personal: 可缩小数据阅读流程；完整配方可能需要多卡。
entries.difference: 给出具体SFT与偏好对齐配方，适合学习实验配置和数据选择。
entries.recommendation: 在TRL基础上读一个配方，理解数据和超参为何这样组合。

en.title: Alignment Handbook
en.summary: Recipes for supervised and preference-based alignment.
en.difference: Emphasizes complete experiment configurations and data choices around existing trainers.
en.recommendation: Read one recipe after learning the trainer it relies on.
en.personal: Choose a small model or notebook first; memory requirements depend on the model, method and configuration.

entries.title: Open R1
entries.summary: 推理模型后训练、数据与评估的开放复现。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 从数据处理和小模型实验读起，再看GRPO配方。
entries.personal: 阅读和小样本优先；完整训练依官方硬件要求。
entries.difference: 开放推理模型复现中的数据、训练与评估，连接合成数据和RL后训练。
entries.recommendation: 完成GRPO小实验后再读，优先追一条数据到评估的链。

en.title: Open R1
en.summary: An open effort around reasoning-model training and evaluation.
en.difference: Connects synthetic data, post-training and evaluation in a research-oriented workflow.
en.recommendation: Read after a small GRPO experiment; follow one data-to-evaluation path.
en.personal: Choose a small model or notebook first; memory requirements depend on the model, method and configuration.

entries.title: LlamaIndex
entries.summary: 面向文档检索、索引和模型应用的数据框架。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 先用少量文档做检索问答，再加重排与评估。
entries.personal: 小文档可本地处理，生成使用模型/API。
entries.difference: 面向数据接入、索引与检索应用的开发框架，比FAISS更接近应用组织。
entries.recommendation: 需要组合文档处理、检索与模型时选它，仍保留独立检索评测。

en.title: LlamaIndex
en.summary: A framework for data-connected LLM applications.
en.difference: Works at a higher application level than FAISS, organizing ingestion, indexing and retrieval.
en.recommendation: Choose it for composable RAG applications while keeping retrieval evaluation explicit.
en.personal: Start with a small document collection; embedding and generation requirements depend on the chosen models.

entries.title: RAGFlow
entries.summary: 围绕文档解析与检索的RAG应用系统。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 先部署演示，导入一组文档，再研究解析和召回。
entries.personal: 本地服务需要一定内存；模型可接外部API。
entries.difference: 集成式知识库与RAG应用，便于快速体验完整系统和文档处理。
entries.recommendation: 想先看产品形态可选它；想理解算法与调用链先做All-in-RAG。

en.title: RAGFlow
en.summary: An integrated RAG and knowledge-base application.
en.difference: Offers a fuller product experience than a low-level retrieval library.
en.recommendation: Use to explore an end-to-end product; build a smaller pipeline first for algorithmic understanding.
en.personal: Start with a small document collection; embedding and generation requirements depend on the chosen models.

entries.title: LangGraph
entries.summary: 用状态图组织工具、记忆与Agent流程。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 先做单Agent工具调用，再加状态、恢复与人工介入。
entries.personal: CPU编排与模型API即可做小项目。
entries.difference: 用显式状态和图组织Agent流程，适合分支、暂停、恢复和持久工作流。
entries.recommendation: 单Agent工具循环跑通后再引入，让复杂状态成为采用框架的理由。

en.title: LangGraph
en.summary: A framework for stateful agent workflows.
en.difference: Makes state transitions and control flow explicit, useful for branching and resumable execution.
en.recommendation: Add it when a working agent needs structured state, not before a basic tool loop.
en.personal: Start with one local tool and a small task; configure an LLM endpoint when generation is needed.

entries.title: AutoGen
entries.summary: 多Agent对话、工具和协作框架。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 先做两个角色的明确任务，再研究消息与工具调用。
entries.personal: 小例子使用模型API；避免一开始加入过多角色。
entries.difference: 以多Agent交互和协作为主要视角，与LangGraph的显式流程视角不同。
entries.recommendation: 有明确角色分工需求时再读；同时参考项目当前维护与迁移说明。

en.title: AutoGen
en.summary: A framework centered on multi-agent interaction.
en.difference: Emphasizes collaboration between agents rather than only an explicit workflow graph.
en.recommendation: Study when role-based collaboration is necessary; consult current maintenance and migration guidance.
en.personal: Start with one local tool and a small task; configure an LLM endpoint when generation is needed.

entries.title: OpenHands
entries.summary: 可操作开发环境的编码Agent。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 先使用演示，再追踪工具执行、会话和环境接口。
entries.personal: 需要容器/运行环境与模型服务。
entries.difference: 完整的软件开发Agent系统，包含执行环境与应用层基础设施。
entries.recommendation: 放在learn-claude-code之后，按沙箱、执行、上下文和评测分模块读。

en.title: OpenHands
en.summary: A complete software-development agent platform.
en.difference: Includes execution environments and application infrastructure beyond a small coding-agent loop.
en.recommendation: Follow a minimal agent implementation, then inspect execution, isolation, context and evaluation.
en.personal: Start with one local tool and a small task; configure an LLM endpoint when generation is needed.

entries.title: Diffusers
entries.summary: 扩散模型的训练与推理工具。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 先用现成pipeline生成，再看调度器和训练样例。
entries.personal: 推理和训练按模型检查GPU要求。
entries.difference: 多种扩散与生成模型的通用实现库，支持训练、推理和管线组合。
entries.recommendation: 从HF Diffusion Course的小模型开始，再读一种scheduler和pipeline。

en.title: Diffusers
en.summary: A library of diffusion and generative-model implementations.
en.difference: Supplies models, schedulers and pipelines rather than one isolated architecture.
en.recommendation: Start with the diffusion course, then inspect one scheduler and one pipeline.
en.personal: Use a small notebook or pretrained pipeline before attempting larger training runs.

entries.title: Segment Anything
entries.summary: 可提示的图像分割模型与示例。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 先跑图像提示分割，再看编码器和mask预测接口。
entries.personal: 先做单张图像推理。
entries.difference: 提示式图像分割模型，用点、框等提示产生掩码；不是目标检测器。
entries.recommendation: 与YOLO比较输出任务，先运行单张图像的提示分割。

en.title: Segment Anything
en.summary: A promptable image-segmentation model.
en.difference: Produces masks from prompts such as points or boxes, unlike an object detector.
en.recommendation: Compare with detection and begin with prompted segmentation on one image.
en.personal: Begin with an official small example; training requirements depend on the model and dataset.

entries.title: Ultralytics YOLO
entries.summary: 目标检测、分割和视觉模型训练工具。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 先跑图像检测，再用小数据做微调。
entries.personal: CPU可做小推理，训练优先GPU。
entries.difference: 成熟视觉任务工具链，适合检测等任务的训练和部署实践。
entries.recommendation: 想练数据标注、指标和部署可先做它，再深入模型结构。

en.title: Ultralytics YOLO
en.summary: A practical toolkit for vision tasks such as object detection.
en.difference: Useful for a complete data-to-deployment workflow, rather than only architecture reading.
en.recommendation: Start with a small labeled dataset, metrics and inference before changing architectures.
en.personal: Begin with an official small example; training requirements depend on the model and dataset.

entries.title: PyTorch Geometric
entries.summary: 图神经网络的数据与算子框架。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 先做节点分类，再比较图分类或链接预测。
entries.personal: 小图数据可用CPU。
entries.difference: 图神经网络工具库，以节点、边和消息传递为核心；与概率图模型不同。
entries.recommendation: 配合CS224W做节点或图分类，重点检查图批处理和信息泄漏。

en.title: PyTorch Geometric
en.summary: A library for graph neural networks.
en.difference: Centers on nodes, edges and message passing, distinct from probabilistic graphical-model inference.
en.recommendation: Pair with CS224W and inspect batching and leakage in a small graph task.
en.personal: Begin with an official small example; training requirements depend on the model and dataset.

entries.title: LLaVA
entries.summary: 连接视觉编码器与语言模型的多模态助手。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 先看图像输入到文本回答，再读连接层与训练阶段。
entries.personal: 可先读代码；训练和推理需要相应GPU。
entries.difference: 将视觉编码器连接到语言模型，适合理解多模态对齐与指令数据。
entries.recommendation: 在语言模型基础后读，先追图像特征如何进入语言模型。

en.title: LLaVA
en.summary: A vision-language model implementation.
en.difference: Connects visual features to a language model and multimodal instruction training.
en.recommendation: Trace how image features enter the language model before attempting fine-tuning.
en.personal: Begin with an official small example; training requirements depend on the model and dataset.

entries.title: CleanRL
entries.summary: 以简洁脚本呈现常见深度强化学习算法。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 选一个PPO或DQN脚本，从环境交互追到策略更新。
entries.personal: 简单环境可在个人电脑上实验。
entries.difference: 以便于阅读的单文件算法实现为特色，适合追loss与交互循环。
entries.recommendation: RL代码入门优先读它，再用Stable-Baselines3组织更多实验。

en.title: CleanRL
en.summary: Readable, compact implementations of RL algorithms.
en.difference: Makes the interaction loop and optimization objective easy to trace.
en.recommendation: Use for algorithm study before moving to a more abstract experiment library.
en.personal: Start with a simple environment; larger visual or robotic experiments need more compute.

entries.title: Stable-Baselines3
entries.summary: 常见强化学习算法的PyTorch实现。
entries.prereq: Python；按主题补充机器学习、PyTorch或相关系统基础。
entry: 先在简单环境训练，再改网络或奖励。
entries.personal: 简单环境可CPU；复杂环境视任务而定。
entries.difference: 稳定、统一接口的RL算法库，更适合搭建基线和重复实验。
entries.recommendation: 做同一环境的算法比较时选它；读原理时参考CleanRL。

en.title: Stable-Baselines3
en.summary: A library of established reinforcement-learning implementations.

entries.summary: 先看网络和梯度下降，再看反传直觉与Backpropagation calculus：从损失沿计算链求权重导数，最后接micrograd代码。
entries.prereq: 基本导数；不熟悉时先看微积分的本质。
entries.language: 不要求编程；代码对照使用Python
entries.audience: 神经网络初学者，以及想补反传推导的人。

en.title: 3Blue1Brown: Neural Networks and Backpropagation
en.summary: Start with networks and gradient descent, then connect backpropagation intuition to the chain-rule derivation and a micrograd implementation.
en.audience: Beginners in neural networks and learners revisiting backpropagation.
en.prereq: Basic derivatives; pair with Essence of Calculus if needed.

entries.title: Hugging Face · Diffusion Course
entries.summary: 从加噪与去噪开始，实现小型扩散模型，再学习微调、条件控制与Diffusers管线。偏动手，MIT 6.S184补连续模型原理。
entries.prereq: Python、PyTorch与基本神经网络。
entries.audience: 会PyTorch，想从Notebook进入图像生成的人。

en.title: Hugging Face Diffusion Course
en.summary: Implements diffusion models, fine-tuning, conditioning and Diffusers pipelines. Complements MIT 6.S184's mathematical treatment.
en.audience: PyTorch users who prefer notebook-based generative-model practice.
en.prereq: Python, PyTorch and introductory deep learning.

entries.title: PyTorch · DDP与FSDP2
entries.summary: 从DDP进入FSDP2，理解参数、梯度和优化器状态的分片及通信。先读官方小例子，再比较DeepSpeed。
entries.prereq: 单卡PyTorch训练、GPU内存与进程基础。
entries.audience: 已会单卡训练，想理解多卡通信与显存分片的人。

en.title: PyTorch Distributed: DDP and FSDP2
en.summary: Introduces DDP and FSDP2, including sharding and communication. Read the official examples before comparing DeepSpeed.
en.audience: Learners moving from single-device training to distributed training.
en.prereq: A working PyTorch training loop, GPU memory and process basics.

entries.title: NeMo Data Designer
entries.summary: 用配置式工作流设计、生成和验证合成数据，支持从种子数据出发组织字段和模型生成。
entries.personal: 可先用Python库和少量样本预览；需要配置模型端点，调用或自托管成本由所用模型决定。
entries.difference: 按列、依赖关系和约束设计合成数据，强调多样性、字段关联与自动验证；与清洗语料的DataTrove分工不同。
entries.recommendation: 数据合成重点项目：从官方preview例子做小表，再加入种子数据和验证器；模型端点另行配置。

en.title: NeMo Data Designer
en.summary: NVIDIA's framework for designing structured synthetic datasets.
en.difference: Uses column-based configuration, dependencies and validation; complements corpus preparation tools rather than replacing them.
en.recommendation: Start with the official preview example, then add seed data and validators. Configure a model endpoint separately.
en.personal: Preview a small dataset with the Python library. Configure a model endpoint separately; inference costs depend on the provider or self-hosted model.

entries.title: DeepSpeed
entries.summary: 面向大模型训练和推理的分布式优化工具，包含ZeRO等显存与通信优化机制。
entries.personal: 可先阅读ZeRO教程与小配置；多卡实验依赖对应GPU环境。
entries.difference: 分布式训练与推理工具，ZeRO等机制帮助组织显存与通信，层次低于具体RLHF工作流。
entries.recommendation: 单卡训练之后先学DDP/FSDP，再读一个ZeRO配置并比较显存分工。

en.title: DeepSpeed
en.summary: Distributed training and inference infrastructure.
en.difference: Mechanisms such as ZeRO address memory and communication below a task-specific RLHF workflow.
en.recommendation: Learn DDP/FSDP first, then inspect one ZeRO configuration and its memory layout.
en.personal: Read ZeRO examples and small configurations first; multi-GPU experiments require the relevant hardware.

entries.title: MCP Python SDK
entries.summary: Model Context Protocol官方Python SDK，用于实现工具、资源与模型应用之间的连接。
entries.personal: 先在本地实现一个小工具服务和客户端；接入模型时再配置所需端点。
entries.difference: 连接模型应用与工具、资源的协议SDK；本身不负责规划、记忆或自主决策。
entries.recommendation: 先做一个小工具服务和客户端，再把它接入已有Agent。

en.title: MCP Python SDK
en.summary: The official Python SDK for Model Context Protocol.
en.difference: Implements tool and resource connectivity; it is not an agent planner or memory system.
en.recommendation: Build a small server and client, then integrate them with an existing agent.
en.personal: Build a small local tool server and client before connecting an LLM endpoint.

entries.title: Python深度学习 · 第三版
entries.summary: François Chollet以Keras生态讲解深度学习概念与应用，适合需要另一种框架视角时查阅。
entries.personal: 商业出版物，获取方式与版本以出版社页面为准。

en.title: Deep Learning with Python, Third Edition
en.summary: Introduces deep-learning concepts through the Keras ecosystem and practical examples.
en.audience: Programmers who want a Keras-oriented companion to PyTorch-based courses.
en.personal: Commercial book; see the publisher for edition and access details.
